description: This module allows the administration of Keycloak client Authorization Scopes using the Keycloak REST API. Authorization Scopes are only available if a client has Authorization enabled.

parameters.name: auth_client_id
parameters.description: OpenID Connect client_id to authenticate to the API with. Default: "admin-cli"

parameters.name: auth_client_secret
parameters.description: Client Secret to use in conjunction with auth_client_id (if required).

parameters.name: auth_password
parameters.description: Password to authenticate for API access with.

parameters.name: auth_realm
parameters.description: Keycloak realm name to authenticate to for API access.

parameters.name: auth_username
parameters.description: Username to authenticate for API access with.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: The clientId of the Keycloak client that should have the authorization scope. This is usually a human-readable name of the Keycloak client.

parameters.name: connection_timeout
parameters.description: Controls the HTTP connections timeout period (in seconds) to Keycloak API. Default: 10

parameters.name: display_name
parameters.description: The display name of the authorization scope.

parameters.name: http_agent
parameters.description: Configures the HTTP User-Agent header. Default: "Ansible"

parameters.name: icon_uri
parameters.description: The icon URI for the authorization scope.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the authorization scope to create.

parameters.name: realm
parameters.description: The name of the Keycloak realm the Keycloak client is in.

parameters.name: refresh_token
parameters.description: Authentication refresh token for Keycloak API.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State of the authorization scope. On present, the authorization scope is created (or updated if it exists already). On absent, the authorization scope is removed if it exists. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Verify TLS certificates (do not disable this in production). Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Manage Keycloak file:delete authorization scope
  keycloak_authz_authorization_scope:
    name: file:delete
    state: present
    display_name: File delete
    client_id: myclient
    realm: myrealm
    auth_keycloak_url: http://localhost:8080/auth
    auth_username: keycloak
    auth_password: keycloak
    auth_realm: master

return_values.name: end_state
return_values.description: Representation of the authorization scope after module execution. Returned: on success

return_values.name: display_name
return_values.description: Display name of the authorization scope. Returned: when state=present Sample: "File delete"

return_values.name: icon_uri
return_values.description: Icon URI for the authorization scope. Returned: when state=present Sample: "http://localhost/icon.png"

return_values.name: id
return_values.description: ID of the authorization scope. Returned: when state=present Sample: "a6ab1cf2-1001-40ec-9f39-48f23b6a0a41"

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: Name of the authorization scope. Returned: when state=present Sample: "file:delete"

return_values.name: msg
return_values.description: Message as to what action was taken. Returned: always
